mrd.text: Pontifex, a vedalken lord, agrees to the council's wish to kill his subject Donal to gain favor with the Synod, which is how Bruenna's father dies.
He later takes Bruenna and Glissa into his house as guests and prisoners, planning to hand them over for a council seat, and boasts that he caused Bruenna's father's death.
He orders Marek to execute Glissa in the Razor Fields against Memnarch's command, and when Kaldra awakens at the Vault of Whispers he retreats.
Descending into Mirrodin's Core to usurp Memnarch, he sends a thresher battalion after Glissa, until Marek and Pontifex kill each other when Pontifex prepares to kill her.

dst.text: Memnarch rebuffs Pontifex's offer to become part of him, and Pontifex blames Glissa and begins going insane, though with Janus dead he ascends to leadership of the Synod.
He tries to kill Orland and orders Glissa's death, testing Marek's loyalty, until Bruenna arrives with Neurok wizards.
Orland then orchestrates a vote returning the Vedalken Empire to a Republic, stripping Pontifex of power, and Pontifex kills two of his former council members before leaving, swearing vengeance.
In the end Marek saves Glissa from Pontifex, and the two kill one another.
